'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Kivu conflict]]
***[[Allied Democratic Forces]] militants kill ten people in an attack on a village in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-islamic-rebel-attack-adf-kivu-makoko-faae44fe327d54ca619acd7c3fb30104 (AP)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
***[[Israel]] and [[Hamas]] reach a diplomatic agreement mediated by [[Egypt]], [[Qatar]], and the [[U.S.]] to initiate a [[ceasefire]] and an end to military operations in the [[Gaza Strip]], as well as to facilitate the exchange of [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostages]] and [[Palestinians in Israeli custody|prisoners]], marking the first major cessation of hostilities since [[2023 Gaza war ceasefire|November 2023]]. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/israel-hamas-gaza-ceasefire-hostages-01-15-24/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
***The [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes a [[Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham]] (HTS) vehicle convoy in [[Quneitra Governorate]], [[Syria]], killing two HTS personnel and the mayor of a local village. It is the first time that Israel has targeted HTS forces since the [[fall of the Assad regime]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/01/15/first-israel-strike-on-new-syria-security-forces-kills-3-medical-source-monitor (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russia]] launches a major ballistic and [[cruise missile]] attack on regions across [[Ukraine]], targeting energy production and compelling authorities to shut down the power grid. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-massive-attack-power-cuts-2dc7a30e36c9eca3e874476374c21eba (AP)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Yemen]]'s [[Houthi movement]] claims that it launched a missile attack targeting the [[USS Harry S. Truman|USS ''Harry S. Truman'']] [[aircraft carrier]] and accompanying warships of the [[United States Navy]] in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/yemen-s-houthis-claim-missile-drone-attack-on-us-aircraft-carrier-in-red-sea/3451441 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Istanbul alcohol poisonings]]
**[[Moonshine|Bootleg alcohol]] kills 37 people and leaves 80 others hospitalized over the last 48 hours in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]]. Turkish health officials say many of those in hospital are in [[Intensive care medicine|intensive care]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/bootleg-alcohol-claims-lives-30-people-istanbul-dozens-117746365 (ABC News)]
*[[Stilfontein mine deaths]]
**Seventy-eight bodies of workers are retrieved from a closed [[illegal mining|illegal]] [[gold mine]] in [[Stilfontein]], [[North West (South African province)|North West Province]], [[South Africa]] following a months-long siege by [[South African Police Service|police]]. Over 200 survivors are arrested as they exit the mine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/body-count-south-african-mine-rescue-operation-rises-60-2025-01-15/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[U.S.]] [[Food and Drug Administration]] bans the usage of [[Red No. 3]] artificial [[food coloring]], due to research showing that the food coloring is [[carcinogen]]ic. [https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/fda-bans-red-no-3-artificial-coloring-beverages-candy-rcna185479 (NBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Poland–Russia relations]]
**[[Poland|Polish]] [[Prime Minister of Poland|Prime Minister]] [[Donald Tusk]] accuses [[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] and his country of [[State-sponsored terrorism|plotting terror attacks]] on [[airliner]]s around the world. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-live-putin-storm-shadow-missiles-b2679782.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**[[Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol]]
***[[Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials|Anti-corruption officials]] and police attempt to breach the [[Office of the President of South Korea|residence]] of [[Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol|impeached]] [[President of South Korea|South Korean president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] for a second time in order to execute an [[arrest warrant]], while facing resistance from the [[Presidential Security Service (South Korea)|Presidential Security Service]], [[People Power Party (South Korea)|People Power Party]] lawmakers, and pro-Yoon protesters. Following a five-hour standoff, Yoon is arrested, becoming [[South Korea]]'s first sitting president to be arrested. [https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250115005200004?rec_id=1736900123005&site=recommendation_view (Yonhap)] [https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20250115069851001 (Yonhap 2)] [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-yoon-martial-law-detain-8dd7f03661be39729741de9a3b5d1714 (AP)]
*[[2024 drone sightings]]
**The [[Federal Government of Germany|German government]] authorises the [[Bundeswehr]] to shoot down suspicious drones seen near military sites or other critical infrastructure with [[Federal Ministry of the Interior (Germany)|Interior Minister]] [[Nancy Faeser]] stating that [[Russia]] is suspected of being behind the drone activity. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce3l2v01y4wo (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024–2025 Georgian protests]]
**A [[general strike]] takes place in [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] with hundreds of Georgian firms urging [[Government of Georgia (country)|the government]] to release all [[political prisoner]]s and hold new elections amid nationwide protests. Former [[Prime Minister of Georgia|Prime Minister]] and opposition leader [[Giorgi Gakharia]] is hospitalized after being assaulted, allegedly by members of the ruling [[Georgian Dream]] party. [https://civil.ge/archives/652251 (Civil Georgia)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cpql9v1r57vo (BBC News)]
*[[2024–2025 Mozambican protests]]
**[[Daniel Chapo]] is sworn in as [[President of Mozambique]], succeeding [[Filipe Nyusi]]. The inauguration takes place amid ongoing political unrest in [[Mozambique]], with opposition leader [[Venâncio Mondlane]] continuing to insist that the [[2024 Mozambican general election|October 2024 election]] was rigged. Since then, over 300 people have died in clashes with Police. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250115-mozambique-inaugurates-president-elect-daniel-chapo-amid-deadly-unrest (France 24)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mozambique-president-sworn-post-election-protest-deaths-rise-2025-01-15/ (Reuters)]
**[[Maria Benvinda Levy]] is appointed [[Prime Minister of Mozambique|Prime Minister]].[https://clubofmozambique.com/news/mozambique-president-names-former-justice-minister-as-prime-minister-274141/ (''Club of Mozambique'')]
*[[Rosen Zhelyazkov]] of the [[GERB–SDS]] coalition is tasked by [[President of Bulgaria|Bulgarian President]] [[Rumen Radev]] with forming the new [[Government of Bulgaria|government]], following the [[October 2024 Bulgarian parliamentary election|parliamentary election]] in October 2024. [https://fakti.bg/en/bulgaria/941822-prezidentat-vrachi-parvia-mandat-na-gerb-sds (Fakti.bg)]
